name: inventarch-marketplace
description: The public InventArch plugin catalogue: the ia plugin and its public method kits

scripts.check: python tools/validate.py && python tools/selection.py --check && node tools/bundle-kits.mjs --check && node tools/kit.mjs index --check && node tools/kit.mjs package --check && python tools/consistency.py && biome lint && node tools/check-language.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:repo && npm run test:tools && npm run test:plugins
scripts.kits:install: node plugins/ia/scripts/kit.mjs add inventarch/ia-method-kit . --apply && node plugins/ia/scripts/kit.mjs add inventarch/ia-kb-kit . --apply && node plugins/ia/scripts/kit.mjs add inventarch/ia-authoring-kit . --apply
